script_text:
Scorpio and Gemini are one of the hardest zodiac pairings. They can really care about each other and still clash all the time.
One of them wants an answer now. The other wants more time.
Maybe it's about taking a trip or deciding where the relationship is going. And Gemini isn't always the one pushing things forward.
Sometimes Scorpio is the one asking, "So what are we doing?"
Then one person feels controlled, and the other feels like the relationship isn't being taken seriously.
After a while, they're not arguing about the plan anymore. They're arguing about whether the other person cares.
